brief:
Israel granted a pardon to soldier Elor Azaria, according to Al Jazeera English. Azaria had been convicted in a military court for the fatal shooting of a Palestinian assailant in Hebron in 2016.

The pardon brings a close to a case that sparked widespread debate over use of force by Israeli security personnel. Azaria's conviction and subsequent legal proceedings had drawn significant public attention and polarized opinion within Israel.

title: Israel pardons soldier Elor Azaria
